cumleler: How much does an earplug labeled 29 really protect?
The foam earplug's noise reduction rating, or NRR, is 29.
The area measures 95 decibels A, so 7 is subtracted first.
OSHA guidance halves the remaining 22 for real-world losses.
Estimated protection is 11 decibels, so about 84 reaches the ear.
Expecting 66 from the label overstates protection almost threefold.
